episodes.synopsis: Takamine is basically a goddess. Shirota is like an NPC, but he glimpses her bare breasts. Weirdness ensues...
episodes.title: Become My Closet

episodes.synopsis: It's Shirota's first day as Takamine's closet. How is he even supposed to pull off what she's asking of him?
episodes.title: Let Me Redo It Until I'm Satisfied.

episodes.synopsis: Shirota learns how much effort Takamine has put in to be who she is. Later she helps him get first place.
episodes.title: I Want You to Enjoy the Very Best

episodes.synopsis: When Shirota gets sick, Takamine nurses him with surprising devotion, making him wonder if it means something.
episodes.title: Don't Be Dense, Be Sharp.

episodes.synopsis: Shirota is over at Takamine's place, but then the lightning knocks out the power and sends her into his arms.
episodes.title: I Want You to Make This Cat Purr, Meow.

episodes.synopsis: Takamine and Shirota roleplay newly-weds. She escalates things by joining him in the bath to wash his back.
episodes.title: Honey, Let Me Wash Your Back.

episodes.synopsis: Takamine and Shirota talk about the future. When he says he's set on work, not college, she briefly looks sad.
episodes.title: Even That Which Isn't Visible From There

episodes.synopsis: Shirota runs into Ellie, a friend from grade school. They're hanging out in the park where Takamine sees them.
episodes.title: You Two Seem Quite Intimate

episodes.synopsis: Takamine challenges Shirota to a water balloon fight, the loser has to obey the winner. What will it be?
episodes.title: Let Me Do It!!

episodes.synopsis: The class will put on the play Cinderella. Naturally, Takamine will be Cinderella, but who will be the prince?
episodes.title: It Rains, and Shirota Freezes Up

episodes.synopsis: To calm Shirota's nerves, Takamine goes into the haunted house with him. It works, but now where is Ouji?
episodes.title: I'll Let You Do a Dry Run

episodes.synopsis: Can Shirota make it to the end of Cinderella without messing up? Near the end, something unexpected happens!
episodes.title: Only Look At Me
